sources.fact: The volume hint may be a handle to any file on the same volume; OPEN_REPARSE_POINT avoids normal reparse processing.
uv__unique_pipe_name uses the non-LOCAL pipe/uv namespace; uv__pipe_server retries ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED as though it were a name collision.
App-container named-pipe support is documented with the LOCAL prefix.
